components.name: Verification code
components.description: One cell per character on top of the CSS only .otp-field: auto advance, Backspace goes back, arrows, Home and End, paste or SMS autofill of the whole code from any cell (spaces and dashes are stripped), error shake and success states, masked mode and a monsoon:otp-complete event. The field stays in the form with the full value. Needs monsoon.js.

options: data-m-otp-length="6" (4 to 8, or the field maxlength)
data-m-otp-type="alphanumeric" (letters and digits, shown upper case)
data-m-otp-webotp (reads the SMS with the WebOTP API where supported)
data-m-otp-name="code" (field name when the markup has no field)

components.name: Authenticator app setup
components.description: Two step setup for a time based authenticator: a QR code drawn in the browser from an otpauth:// URI (no image, no dependency), the setup key in groups of four with a copy button behind a "Can't scan the code?" disclosure, then the first code to confirm. Needs monsoon.js for the QR code and the code cells.
components.html:

components.name: QR code
components.description: A QR code generated in the browser (byte mode, error correction level M, versions 1 to 10, up to 213 bytes) as a crisp SVG. Dark modules stay on a light tile in dark mode too, so every camera can read it. Three sizes. Needs monsoon.js.

options: data-m-qr-mask="0" (0 to 7, chosen automatically when left out)

components.name: Recovery codes
components.description: One time recovery codes in a two column grid with copy all, download as a .txt file and print. Used codes are struck through, and Continue stays disabled until "I saved these codes" is checked. Needs monsoon.js for the actions.

options: data-codes-action="copy | download | print | confirm | continue" on the parts

components.name: Verify screen
components.description: The second step after the password: masked destination, code cells that submit when complete, a resend link with a countdown, another method link and a "Don't ask again on this device for 30 days" checkbox. Needs monsoon.js for the cells and the countdown.

options: data-m-auth-resend-idle (starts enabled, counts after the first click)
data-m-auth-resend-done="You can request a new code now." (announced at zero)
events: monsoon:auth-resend { seconds } (cancelable: preventDefault() keeps it enabled)

components.name: Security key and passkey
components.description: Prompt for a passkey or a hardware security key: an animated key mark, the steps, platform hints (Touch ID, Windows Hello, Android, USB or NFC keys) and error, retry and success states through classes. The page calls WebAuthn and switches the classes.

notes: UI only: call navigator.credentials.get({ publicKey }) (or create() to register) when the screen opens, with the challenge and allowCredentials from your server.

Add .auth-key-error to the .auth-key element when the promise rejects (NotAllowedError means cancelled or timed out) and show the Retry button; add .auth-key-success when your server accepts the assertion.
Put the message in .auth-key-message (role="status"), it is shown only in the error and success states.

components.name: Phone number
components.description: Phone number with a country picker: a searchable list with flags and dial codes, formatting as you type for the selected country, typing or pasting +44 or 0044 switches the country, and a hidden field with the E.164 number. Without the script the native select and tel input still work. Needs monsoon.js.

events: monsoon:auth-phone { country, dial, national, e164, valid }
